title: Running Commentary on Torah 49 — La-Shemesh Sam Ohel
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 49 — לשמש שם אהל
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. 16-segment coarse structure preserves Rabbeinu's own ois-marking (א–ז). Torah 49 is a major wedding-teaching unpacking *'la-shemesh sam ohel ba-hem, v-hu k-chasan yotzei me-chupaso'* (Tehillim 19:5) as a cosmogonic-messianic-musical drash threading: (א) tzimtzum → chalal panui → olamos = middos; lev = tzir ha-middos; 2 yetzarim = 2 machshavos (tovos/ra'os); (ב) tefilah-b-lev = malchus-David revealed in the chalal; (ג) the letter ה made from ד (dalus-da'as) + י (kedushas-machshavah, asarah); (ד) tefilah/malchus rising = 'hi ha-olah' = 'mi zos olah' = both beitim (ila'ah+tata'ah) ascending together; (ה) the l-asid-lavo song: shir pashut-kaful-m-shulash-m-ruba + asarah minei n-gina = ה (ד+י); (ו) teshuvah = osiyos tashuv-ה; aleh shel teshuvah; m-kareves ha-geulah; (ז) tzitzis/techeles d-achli kula v-shatzei kula; peirush (seg 9) of the opening pasuk as tzaddik=shemesh receiving zerichah/gvurah via Yisrael; chupah-practice halachos (tallis, ma'os, zemiros, 'Shabbos!' shout) all decoded as the same ד→ה→Atika chain; R"N's inclusio-editorial marker (seg 14-15) + supplement (seg 16) on Yoma 71a 'malei g-ronam shel t"ch yayin'.
